snippet.title: BUCKET TIME - Rando Camp Gameplay snippet.
snippet.description:
A short gameplay snippet to go along with the new progress update for the game here:


While you're here, if you're interested in working on the game and got the skills™, check out the new recruitment form! We're looking for artists to join and work on the game.

Link to the discord server: https://discord.gg/XnjMbq3yU9
